Priya Shah: Quick check — Aurora Labs beta enrollment. Need to confirm: 3 seats, SSO + KMS access, and opt-in for telemetry sampling. Planning a readiness call Thurs 3pm PT. Who owns NDAs?

Sam Green: I can own the enablement deck. Thurs 3pm works. Can infra get SSO + KMS scoped by Wed EOD?

Tyler Nguyen: I asked infra, they're ok but need the org ID and contact email for the staging toggle. telemetry is behind feature flag `aurora_beta_telemetry`.

Priya Shah: Org ID: `aurora-labs-42`. Contact: eng+aurora@auroralabs.com. Invite to staging sent. NDAs — I think Legal owns but CS should follow up.

Marta Lopez: I'll chase Legal tomorrow AM. Note: we need explicit consent for sampling logs and PII scrubber turned on by default. I'll drop the consent template in a sec.

Ben (CS Manager): :thumbsup: Heads-up — renewal risk drops to low if we hit a successful POC within 30 days. Recommend 2-week enablement sprint: week 1 onboarding + setup, week 2 metrics walk + 1 eval. Suggest daily async updates in this thread.

cs-bot: Reminder: onboarding survey for Aurora Labs due in 48 hours — https://forms.redwood/cs/aurora-beta (automated)

Sam Green: Cool. I'll prep the 30-min enablement agenda: 1) SSO/KMS check 2) SDK quickstart 3) telemetry and eval plan. Posting draft here after lunch.

Priya Shah: Thanks all. I'll schedule the Thurs call, share invite + agenda, and attach the consent template once Marta posts it. Also adding a feedback capture doc: https://docs.redwood/aurora/beta-feedback. Will update after call.

Tyler Nguyen: FYI if Legal needs logs masked we can use `mask_pii=true` on the staging bucket. Command to enable:```bash
redwood infra toggle --org aurora-labs-42 --feature aurora_beta_telemetry --enable 
# then set mask_pii=true
```

Marta Lopez: Consent template posted: https://drive.redwood/legal/aurora-consent-v1. I'll follow up with Legal contact.

Priya Shah: Perfect. Daily status: I'll ping this thread with a quick 1-liner after each checkpoint. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
